faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Go to the Touchpoint Manager tab, click "+ Add New Touch Point", enter the station name, and assign a staff member if needed. The QR code is generated instantly and can be printed or simulated.
faq.a2: Nexora touch points route tips directly to the technician's connected Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, or VLINKPAY address. Funds go straight to their account without processing delays or owner intervention.
faq.q3: How to set up VLINKPAY Wallet?
faq.a3: Navigate to Settings -> Profile tab, scroll down to Payout Methods, and enter your VLINKPAY Wallet identifier. Once verified, customers will see VLINKPAY as a direct tipping option.
faq.a4: You can order custom laser-engraved NFC wooden stands or tabletop cards directly from the Manage Plan / Subscriptions tab, or by contacting our support team with your salon station count.
